title: Contract-first Hosted Endpoint PRD: Risk-driven Acceptance & Launch Checklist
creator: Amina Patel
description: Product requirements document for a contract-first approach to the hosted inference surface (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank). Focus: clarify behavioral contracts, enumerate acceptance gates driven by risk profiles, and provide a stepwise launch checklist that ties PRD decisions to operational runbooks and rollback criteria.
goals: Define canonical API contracts for chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank with minimal ambiguity
Create risk-prioritized acceptance criteria that balance cost/latency with correctness
Deliver a repeatable launch checklist that reduces last-minute scope churn and cross-team confusion
Ensure observable telemetry and SLOs are in place before production traffic is routed
success_metrics: Contract conformance test pass rate >= 99% on staging
End-to-end median p95 latency <= 250ms for small-chat baseline under 50rps in Dedicated test pool
Embedding vector dimensionality and checksum validation errors < 0.1%
Canary error budget burn within first 24h < 10%
No P0 reliability incidents attributable to API surface mismatches during first 7 days
out_of_scope: Server-side model training, fine-tuning, or dataset ingestion
Custom private deployment packaging changes (Private-specific infra changes are separate project)
Major SDK language feature additions (only compatibility shims as needed)
assumptions: Underlying runtime supports streaming and blocking response modes for the same model variants
Model catalog includes a verified embedding model with stable vector size (e.g., 1536) for launch
Customers expect backward-compatible JSON fields for 90 days after GA
Dedicated capacity autoscaler will provide testable burst behavior in staging
acceptance_criteria: API contract spec published (OpenAPI + behavioral notes) and accepted by API and Runtime leads
Schema validation tests for inputs/outputs pass in CI with sample payloads (chat messages, completion prompts, embedding batches, rerank candidates)
Streaming contract validated with an end-to-end harness: chunk ordering, reconnect semantics, and finalization events pass against spec
Function/tool-calling integration for chat documented and verified with two reference integrations (simple tool + proxy tool)
Embeddings: vector length check, L2 normalization check (where required), and deterministic checksum tests for canonical inputs
Rerank: signed request/response schema with ranking scores normalized to [0,1], and tie-breaking behavior specified
SLOs and alert thresholds defined and wired into Console dashboards (latency, error rate, token cost per request)
Canary plan documented with traffic slices, success windows, and automatic rollback triggers (e.g., >5% user-facing errors or >20% SLO degradation)
Security review completed and any remediation tracked with issues (no open P0 security findings)
Docs: API reference, example quickstarts for each surface (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank), and migration notes for older endpoints published
SDKs: minimal compatibility smoke tests pass for JavaScript and Python SDKs using new contracts
Load test: sustained 30-minute run at expected GA TPS with <2% increase in error rate vs baseline
launch_checklist: Finalize and freeze API contract (OpenAPI + behavioral appendix) - owner: Priya
Merge runtime compatibility PR and tag runtime-1.22 - owner: Kunal
End-to-end regression suite green on staging for all surfaces - owner: SRE team
Canary runbook created and playbook rehearsed with on-call rotation - owner: Lara
Create Console dashboards: per-model latency token-cost breakdown, top-10 failing requests sample - owner: Observability team
Security review report uploaded and mitigations closed - owner: Tomas
Publish developer quickstarts and code samples in docs site and GitHub - owner: DevRel
SDK patch releases with compatibility shims and changelog - owner: SDK team
Billing & quotas integration verified (rate limit headers, usage reporting) - owner: Billing eng
Prepare rollback artifact: previous endpoint config, automated routing switch, and communication template - owner: Product
Run 2h chaos/latency injection on staging to validate graceful degradation and fallbacks - owner: SRE
Stakeholder sign-offs: Product, Runtime Eng, API Eng, SRE, Security - acceptances recorded in PRD
GA announcement draft and customer-facing migration notes - owner: GTM
risks_mitigations: Risk: Ambiguous streaming semantics cause client regressions -> Mitigation: publish a streaming conformance test and require SDKs to pass it
Risk: Model variant mismatch across regions -> Mitigation: add a 'model-compatible' header and preflight check that fails fast with clear error codes
Risk: Unexpected token cost spikes -> Mitigation: enable token-cost telemetry in canary and set soft quota alerts for early detection
Risk: Rerank score nondeterminism across versions -> Mitigation: include score-seed and deterministic evaluation harness in CI
notes_and_updates: 2026-02-21: Initial PRD draft posted to Confluence - https://confluence.redwood.ai/prd/contract-first-hosted-endpoints
2026-02-25: Design review — Minh requested explicit examples of multi-turn context trimming; decision: implement a server-side prefix-eviction policy and document deterministic behavior
2026-03-01: Runtime lead Kunal noted that current kernel selection may add 10-20ms p95 for large-history chat; trade-off captured in acceptance criteria (p95 allowance for long-history flows)
2026-03-05: Security review kickoff; Tomas requested threat model for rerank candidate ingestion; mitigation: sanitize candidate metadata and enforce strict size limits
2026-03-08: Observability team deployed telemetry alpha to staging; discovered increased token cost for batched embedding requests — added a batching-config tuning task

2026-03-12: Canaries rehearsed in staging with synthetic traffic. Two findings: (1) reconnects after streaming interruptions dropped ephemeral tokens; added fix ENG-43945; (2) embedding checksum mismatch due to rounding in GPU quantization — temporary acceptance criteria added for GA with rollout of fix in runtime-1.23
2026-03-14: Product review: approved to proceed to restricted canary pending closure of ENG-43945 and SEC-1120 remediation items
